description: This file implements an Android Service class called RemoteService which runs in a separate process. It provides IPC via AIDL interfaces, manages callbacks, shows a notification when active, and includes inner classes demonstrating binding to the service, including starting, stopping, and binding activities. The code includes detailed handling of IPC, notifications, and activity-service interactions.

classes.name: RemoteService
classes.description: Main Service class implementing remote IPC, notification management, and callback handling.

classes.name: RemoteService.Controller
classes.description: Inner class Activity for starting/stopping the service.

classes.name: RemoteService.Binding
classes.description: Inner class Activity for binding and interacting with the remote service, including callbacks.

classes.name: RemoteService.BindingOptions
classes.description: Inner class Activity demonstrating binding with different options.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service, sets up notification, starts handler for periodic tasks.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles start commands, logs start intents.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources, cancels notification, removes handler messages.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns IPC binder based on intent action.

methods.name: showNotification
methods.description: Creates and posts a notification to indicate service is running.
